nurse.text: Fàilte, and welcome to Fort William Sanctuary. It sits at the foot of the Ben, so we see a lot of tired teams. Pop yours on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Have a seat. The kettle's on, the shortbread's out and the radiator is, miraculously, working. Don't mind the rain. It's a local.
All better! Mòran taing for waiting. The Great Glen's next: all lochs and long views. Pack a coat. And another coat.
The Ark terminal. It's behind the boot rack. The boot rack is the most important thing in the building.

else.text: No bother. Beannachd leibh. If you see the summit, send a postcard.
